verdict.rationale: Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and returns a reviewable diagnosis. Investigation rules make it run automatically on chosen alerts, before anyone asks. It is documented to analyze code changes, telemetry (e.g., AWS CloudWatch via connectors), and past incidents, backed by related-incident matching and investigation memory. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of investigation quality, and in-depth first-party docs on change correlation (only a marketing-page claim plus a generic code-connector mention).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks

citations.quote: Rootly AI SRE investigates active alerts and incidents, tests likely causes against live evidence, and gives responders a reviewable diagnosis with recommended next steps.
Investigation rules decide which alerts Rootly AI SRE investigates automatically
Rootly AI SRE analyzes your code changes, telemetry, and past incidents to quickly identify root causes and the fix
Rootly AI matches your incident against everything your team already solved.
Connecting AWS lets Rootly AI look up CloudWatch metrics, EC2 instance state, RDS database status, SQS queue depth, and other AWS services during investigations.
